inputs.label: Headers
inputs.description: Custom headers (standard headers like User-Agent, Accept, etc. are added automatically)

inputs.label: Timeout (ms)
inputs.description: Request timeout in milliseconds (default: 300000 = 5 minutes, max: 600000 = 10 minutes)

inputs.label: Retries
inputs.description: Number of retry attempts for timeouts, 429 responses, and 5xx errors (default: 0, no retries)

inputs.label: Retry delay (ms)
inputs.description: Initial retry delay in milliseconds (exponential backoff)

inputs.label: Max retry delay (ms)
inputs.description: Maximum delay between retries in milliseconds

inputs.label: Retry non-idempotent methods
inputs.description: Allow retries for POST/PATCH requests (may create duplicate requests)

inputs.label: Proxy URL
inputs.description: Optional. Route this request through an http:// proxy (e.g. a residential proxy). Must be http://; the proxy host must be publicly reachable. Keep credentials in an environment variable and reference it like {{PROXY_URL}}.
